planPhases.title: Create src/db/migrations/004_users.sql — users table with id, email, username, password, created_at columns
Create src/schemas/authSchema.ts — Zod schemas for register (email, username, password) and login (email, password) request bodies
Create src/services/authService.ts — register (bcrypt hash + uuid + DB insert + JWT sign), login (bcrypt compare + JWT sign), getById (DB lookup, no password field)
planPhases.notes: Created authService.ts with register/login/getById. Installed bcrypt and jsonwebtoken via manual symlinks from pnpm store (private registry blocks direct install). Added them to package.json. Build passes cleanly.

planPhases.title: Create src/middleware/requireJwt.ts — verifies Bearer JWT from Authorization header using JWT_SECRET, attaches decoded payload to req; returns 401 on missing/invalid/expired token
planPhases.notes: Created requireJwt.ts middleware. Verifies Bearer JWT using JWT_SECRET, attaches decoded payload to req.jwtPayload, returns 401 on missing/invalid/expired token. Build passes cleanly.

planPhases.title: Create src/controllers/authController.ts — register handler (201 + user+token), login handler (200 + user+token or 401), me handler (200 user object); wire 409 for duplicate email/username
planPhases.notes: Created authController.ts with registerHandler (201 + user+token), loginHandler (200 + user+token), meHandler (200 user object). Errors propagated via next(err) so errorHandler handles 409/401 automatically. Build passes. Tests return 404 because routes are not mounted yet (phase 6).

planPhases.title: Create src/routes/authRoutes.ts and update src/app.ts to mount auth routes at /api/auth — POST /register, POST /login, GET /me (requireJwt)
planPhases.notes: Created authRoutes.ts wiring POST /register (validate+registerHandler), POST /login (validate+loginHandler), GET /me (requireJwt+meHandler). Mounted at /api/auth in app.ts. All 34 tests pass, build clean.
